name: Weaving & Lace of the World
subtitle: Gul carpet, Lace & more
shortDescription: 9 weaving, lace and embroidery traditions to play: Turkmen gul carpet, Lao silk brocade weaving, Amazigh Rug Weaving and Sadu Bedouin ground-loom weaving.
longDescription:
Weaving & Lace of the World: 9 weaving, lace and embroidery traditions from 8 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Turkmen gul carpet, Lao silk brocade weaving, Amazigh Rug Weaving, Sadu Bedouin ground-loom weaving, Kani shawl weaving by talim code, Lefkara Lace, Chikankari white embroidery, Nakshi kantha embroidery and Haapsalu lace shawl knitting.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can design woven cloth, lace and embroidery patterns, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
